entities.summary: Barry Stuart Sternlicht is an American billionaire and the co-founder, chairman, and CEO of Starwood Capital Group, an investment fund with over $100 billion in assets under management. He is also chairman of Starwood Property Trust. He is the founder of Starwood Hotels and Resorts Worldwide and was its chairman and CEO from 1995 to 2005. As of May 2023, his net worth was estimated at $4.6 billion.
